name: A10-0121/2026 – Isabella Lövin – § 9/1
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: ‘Calls for the prevention of irreversible ecological damage to herring and sprat populations in the Baltic Sea in order to secure the long-term viability of coastal and small-scale fisheries targeting those species and safeguarding marine food webs;’
